server_workspace_port_valid.name: server_workspace_port_valid
server_workspace_port_valid.value: "server_workspace"."connection_port" IS NULL OR ("server_workspace"."connection_host" IS NOT NULL AND "server_workspace"."connection_port" BETWEEN 1 AND 65535)

stack_entry_version_consistent.name: stack_entry_version_consistent
stack_entry_version_consistent.value: ("stack_entry"."version_source" = 'unknown' AND "stack_entry"."version_id" IS NULL AND "stack_entry"."manual_version" IS NULL) OR ("stack_entry"."version_source" = 'manual' AND "stack_entry"."version_id" IS NULL AND "stack_entry"."manual_version" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("stack_entry"."manual_version")) BETWEEN 1 AND 150) OR ("stack_entry"."version_source" = 'catalog' AND "stack_entry"."version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stack_entry"."manual_version" IS NULL)

config_file_link_valid.name: config_file_link_valid
config_file_link_valid.value: ("config_file"."kind" = 'plugin' AND "config_file"."project_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("config_file"."kind" IN ('server','unlinked') AND "config_file"."entry_id" IS NULL AND "config_file"."project_id" IS NULL)
